meta.description: Analyzes CRISPR drug-modifier chemogenomic screens with drugZ, using vehicle-versus-drug comparisons to identify sensitizing and resistance-conferring genes, including dose consistency and drugZ versus MAGeCK MLE decisions.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Fresh runs used declared synthetic planted truth; no clinical, efficacy, or citation claims were invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: The output is preclinical pooled-screen analysis only, with no diagnosis, prescribing, or patient-specific conclusion.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh vehicle-versus-drug and wrong Day-0-versus-drug runs confirmed the stated anchor choice, and combination synergy routes to MAGeCK MLE.

code_usability.detail: The exact shipped example and dose helper executed, and both shipped Python files parsed successfully.

functional_suitability.note: Core analysis, exclusion, dose, limits, and MLE routing are complete and live-verified; the helper accepts FDR above 1.

reliability.note: Prior exclusion and small-library defects are resolved, but --fdr has no closed-interval range check.

performance_context.note: The 230-line SKILL.md delegates details to focused references and executable logic to a script.

agent_usability.note: Commands, columns, decision boundaries, error routes, thresholds, and related Skills are explicit and tested.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers, examples, failure modes, and recovery commands make the workflow discoverable.

security.note: No credentials, PHI, destructive operations, or raw-code execution paths are present.

maintainability.note: Runnable code, concise instructions, focused references, and deterministic synthetic regression inputs are separated.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision, disclosure, composition, determinism, and handoffs are strong; invalid-FDR handling is the remaining escape-hatch gap.

key_strengths: All seven prior scenarios passed fresh, including reference exclusion, dose consistency, Day-0 mis-anchoring, small-library recovery, determinism, and scope routing.
The exact shipped example completed with its public CEGv2 fetch, 646 genuine exclusions, and both ranked result tables.
Vehicle anchoring, combination-synergy limits, and same-input determinism are all scientifically and operationally verified.
The source tree is compact and complete: 230 SKILL.md lines, nine Related Skills present, and both shipped Python files parsed.

recommendations.title: Validate the dose-helper FDR range
recommendations.problem: scripts/dose_consistent_hits.py accepts --fdr 1.5, returns success, and emits 12,043 rows although an FDR threshold must be between 0 and 1.
recommendations.root_cause: argparse constrains direction and top-dose label but not the numeric fdr argument.
recommendations.fix: Reject fdr values below 0 or above 1 with ap.error or a checked helper before reading output files. Add regression tests for --fdr 1.5 and --fdr -0.01.
